title: 2198. Converting Hours and Minutes into Total Minutes Using a Function
description:
198
. 
Converting Hours and Minutes into Total Minutes Using a Function
30
Easy
Problem Statement
Read a duration given in hours and minutes and print the total number of minutes, using a function that takes two parameters.
Description
Read two integers hours and minutes from input. Write a function totalMinutes that takes two integer parameters, converts the hours into minutes (1 hour is 60 minutes), adds the remaining minutes, and returns the total. Call the function from main() and print the returned value.
Input Description
Two integers hours and minutes separated by a space.
Output Description
Print the total number of minutes.
Sample Input
2 30
Sample Output
150
